title: Harmonica as a boy, then drum lessons in 1925
summary: He played harmonica as a boy, took drum lessons in 1925 and began playing with Kid Howard in 1926.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: When you were a boy, did you play any instrument at all when you were a kid?
No, I didn't. No harmonica. That's what I mean. That's an instrument there.
Or even a little tin pipe.

Well, I used to play a harmonica when I was a kid. I played that for long until I got to be a man, young man. Then I started out taking lessons with drums in 1925. And in 26, I started out, I mean, in 26, I started out with Howard.
